meta.name: lipsync-stage-spec
meta.note: Source of truth for all numbers, colours and rules. Scene design (which appliance does what, when) is NOT in this file: it is the next session. Perimeter/button glow in the demos is illustration, not spec.

stage.buttonPlacement: both sides of the catwalk entrance (bottom of the stem); too far apart for one person to press both
stage.buttonLamp: on/off only, no colour (from the meeting; unconfirmed). Pole strips carry all colour.
stage.poles: each button sits on top of a pole; the pole strip fills from the bottom up toward the button
stage.sideConvention: left/right as seen standing at the entrance facing the stage
stage.sensors: none in v1 (no mic, no camera). The crowd claps for real.

pink.role: together, peak, camp brand. Always drifting, liveliest of the set.

white.role: turn the thunder, fail blink. Red is banned (clashes with pink on strips).

tunablesUi.where: the existing control interface (already in development), no new screen

games.inSong: existing solo behaviour, unchanged; never a two-voice song
regular stage; must end with both singing
verses alternate starting LEFT (lime) then right (blue), choruses both (pink), final section always both. Intro/bridge/outro handling: TBD (see open).

lifecycle.afterSong: return to idle; the next game needs a fresh launch gesture; no auto-next
lifecycle.ending: duet and showoff always end with both players together; every other ending is plain. No applause round, no score.
lifecycle.afterSkip: new song, same game (whether the intro replays: TBD)

launch.rule: Presses on opposite buttons whose FIRST presses are within syncWindowMs are 'together'. Decision time = max(soloWaitMs, syncWindowMs) after the last press. Together + equal counts 1..matchMaxCount => game by count. Together + different counts, or count > matchMaxCount => fail gesture. Not together => solo of the earlier button.
launch.latePress: a first press on the other button after syncWindowMs is not part of the launch: it neither joins nor restarts the wait; it is then an ordinary in-song press.
launch.poleFeedback: each click fills the presser's own pole to launchPcts (33 / 66 / 100 %)
launch.success: the matched game's 3-2-1 intro starts immediately (count 3 = poles at 100%). No extra flash before it: the intro is the 3 seconds.
launch.fail: poles blink alternately L,R,L,R (white, failBlinkCount x failBlinkMs), then the last lit pole fades to 0 over failFadeMs, then idle. Nothing starts. No red.

perGame.duet: pink on both sides, animated gradient, brightness steps up each count
perGame.showoff: 3: left side in left colour. 2: right side in right colour. 1: both sweep inward and merge into pink (a happy joining). Poles keep player colours (L lime, R blue) until the merge.
perGame.thunder: white only. 3: left side. 2: right side. 1: centre (catwalk + middle).

intro.binding: pole percentages, timing and outcomes are binding; perimeter/wash drawing is illustration for the scene session
intro.afterIntro: song starts, pole at 0%, scene takes over

applause.thunderException: during countdown/window only the dark pole can applaud

stop.gesture: long press on both buttons together (within syncWindowMs of each other)
stop.soloException: one button is enough in solo

thunder.firstWindowAt: the section change that ends verse 2
thunder.windowsAt: the end of verse 2, then every everySections-th section change after it to the end of the song; never at a change into the final section; a window whose countdown would start before the previous window ends is dropped
thunder.why: first window is after verse 2, which is after the skip cutoff; a countdown only exists to lead into a window
thunder.poleChoice: random per window; the other pole is dark

phases.pole: keeps climbing to 100%, pulses at double rate

phases.trigger: press on active pole in [sectionChange - graceMs, windowEnd]
phases.effect: half-beat blackout, new look, smoke puff

phases.trigger: press on active pole after countdown start and before sectionChange - graceMs
phases.effect: pole falls to 0 in earlyFallMs; countdown and window cancelled; whoever is on stage gets an empowering halo for flareBars

thunder.windowBeats: windowBeatsShort if that lasts >= minWindowMs, else windowBeatsLong
thunder.defend: early press by the performer or a friend is allowed on purpose (feature)
benched: riser sound under the last 4 beats
thunder.illustrationOnly: perimeter chase rings, downbeat flicker and button blink in the demo are not decided

fields.atMs: int (time into the song when skip/stop happened)

fields.section: int (1-based, the section whose end the window is at)

notes: Events only, anonymous; the file is pulled after the burn.
Every number answers a question. No question, no number.
